messages.subject: Change of venue: main hall moved to Salon Jouffroy
messages.body:
Hello,

The main hall we had booked for the event on 21 November 2026 is no longer available. We are proposing to move the event to Salon Jouffroy (Paris 9e), reached by metro at Grands-Boulevards (lines 8 and 9). The move is pending final confirmation and we will let you know once it is confirmed.

The opening session is now expected to start at 09:00 as before, but please note that the opening and contest rounds are being shifted as listed in the updated schedule. Lunch moves to 12:00-13:00. Contest round 1 is now 09:30-12:00, contest round 2 is 13:00-16:00, and the awards session is 16:30-17:00.

We apologise for the disruption and will share the full updated schedule shortly.

We apologise for the change and will be in touch with any further updates.

The skill references a `reference.md` for the exact shape. Let me read it.

Key constraints from the user: don't create files (omit `files`), one message per affected group with `group` set to the group id, `to` = a single person's email from people.csv or a short description, and `revised_schedule` lists only items whose time or place changes. Groups with `effect: inform` and no time/place change still get a message describing the venue change.

Points to note:
- `grp_caterer` is an affected group, but the chosen scenario's catering changes are location-only, so the message covers that.
- Attendee and workshop participant addresses are not in people.csv, so I use short descriptions.
- `volunteer_tasks` is for work the organizer must act on; I'll keep it to confirming the meet-up point, since the hall address is unknown.
- `grp_caterer`'s "to" has no contact in the files, so I use a description.
- Salon Jouffroy's availability is unconfirmed, so messages must say the move is pending confirmation and must not claim the venue is booked.
